nodes.label: area-1-2-1-data-representation (The Switchyard)
nodes.rationale: startRoomId room-binary-hall; lives 3; rooms score 0.

nodes.label: Room: The Binary Hall (hub)
nodes.rationale: Zone hub and startRoomId with a painted route diagram giving two clues per gated exit (N6).

nodes.label: V4 walkthrough trace
nodes.rationale: 18-step path from startRoomId to game-won; four review passes closed V4 findings.

nodes.label: NPC: the foreman
nodes.rationale: Owns hub-side stacks-sealed disarm and four always-active SHOW topics producing the leaf flags.

nodes.label: Spec topic: switch-to-bit
nodes.rationale: 1.1.1 awareness-depth prologue topic. Covered with teaching and retrieval only; maxScore 0 avoids double-scoring against the parked hardware-ethics-and-history topic.

nodes.label: Puzzle: set the switches
nodes.rationale: Denary 37 to binary 100101; USE gauge on belt sets switches-set.

nodes.label: Spec topic: number-conversion
nodes.rationale: Covered: denary/binary/hex conversion, binary addition, arithmetic shifts and overflow/underflow. Worked values 37 to 100101 and 10100101 to A5.

nodes.label: Hazard: carry overflow
nodes.rationale: on-room-enter with once: true; nibble card disarms and sets hex-read.

nodes.label: Hazard: switch overheat
nodes.rationale: on-room-enter with once: true so re-entry is safe and in-room gauge disarm works.

nodes.label: Item: switch gauge
nodes.rationale: USE on belt sets switch-cooled and switches-set; SHOW to foreman sets overflow-checked.

nodes.label: Spec topic: sound-representation
nodes.rationale: Covered: sample, channels, sample rate, bit depth and bit rate = sample rate x bit depth.

nodes.label: Spec topic: data-types
nodes.rationale: Covered: Boolean, character, integer, real and string via five spec-example bins plus one unlabelled decimal sample matched to real.

nodes.label: Spec topic: ai-ethics-and-implications
nodes.rationale: In progress: framing only in this zone; full ethics coverage needs a later zone.

nodes.label: Spec topic: character-representation
nodes.rationale: Covered: ASCII and Unicode; the spare ŵ tile is a subtle Welsh reference labelled only 'a different character'.

nodes.label: Spec topic: data-compression
nodes.rationale: Covered: lossy/lossless principles and compression ratios; spec examples only.

nodes.label: Spec topic: graphics-representation
nodes.rationale: Covered: vector/raster, resolution, bit depth and colour depth in bits per channel.

nodes.label: Spec topic: data-storage-units
nodes.rationale: Covered: base-2 chain bit to PB with 1 KB = 1,024 bytes.

nodes.label: Hazard: bit rot
nodes.rationale: on-room-enter with once: true; stacks-sealed owned by two NPC topics.

nodes.label: Puzzle: make room for the Welsh letter
nodes.norm_label: puzzle: make room for the welsh letter

nodes.label: Item: comic sans cartridge
nodes.rationale: Expendable joke item; using it triggers hazard-detention-bell; required by no puzzle.

nodes.label: Item: nibble card
nodes.rationale: USE on lamp sets carry-cleared; USE on groups sets hex-read; SHOW to foreman sets capacity-labelled.

nodes.label: Item: sample fork
nodes.rationale: USE on desk sets sound-sampled; USE on ladder sets stacks-sorted; SHOW to foreman sets bit-rate-counted.
